title: SeedVR2 Upscale
description: Batch upscale and restore videos and photos with official SeedVR2 (one-step diffusion, ICLR 2026). Send an image_url, a video_url, or a zip; get files of the same type and name plus results.json. Headless wrapper around official projects/inference_seedvr2_3b.py — no Gradio, no ComfyUI, not SeedVR v1.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080,-NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090,-NVIDIA B200,-NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

input.name: Model
input.description: SeedVR2 checkpoint. Default is official SeedVR2-3B (bf16 autocast, one-step, ~13.57 GiB, realistic on a 24 GB card for a small photo). 7B is a 48 GB+ option only and is not the smoke path. Weights are public (no token) and are cached on a network volume when one is attached; they are not baked into the image.

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Pinned weights revision (do not switch to a floating main). Leave empty to use the default pin for the selected model (3B: 37255ff8cccfb01071b87f635a5948ca8d53117c).

input.name: Default single image URL
input.description: https URL of one image (jpg/png/webp/bmp/tiff). Usually sent per job (input.image_url).

input.name: Default single video URL
input.description: https URL of one video (mp4/mov/webm/mkv/...). Usually sent per job (input.video_url). Long 720p clips are officially documented on H100 80 GB, not as a 4090 guarantee.

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz of images and/or videos. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url).

input.name: Output height (area)
input.description: Official argparse res_h. The script resizes to the geometric mean sqrt(res_h*res_w) then crops to a multiple of 16 — not exactly 720x1280. Default 720.

input.name: Output width (area)
input.description: Official argparse res_w. Used with res_h as the geometric-mean area. Default 1280.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the results zip + results.json. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token with write access, only needed for HF_OUTPUT_REPO. SeedVR2 weights are public Apache-2.0 and do not need a token. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Never put the token in the job input.
